description:
1. Powerful 250W Motor & Compliance Speed:

Equipped with a built-in powerful 250W brushless motor and Dynamo Hub 2.0 noise reduction technology, the HILAND Spokane delivers an impressive 46 N.M of motor torque for effortless climbing. It perfectly complies with European road regulations with a safe top speed of 25 KM/H, ensuring a smooth, quiet, and high-speed ride across various terrains.

2. Premium Internal & UL-Certified Battery:

Features an upgraded 36V 10.4Ah internal battery seamlessly integrated into the frame. The removable, waterproof, and crash-resistant design significantly decreases theft rates and prevents accidental detachment. With a fast 4-5 hours charging time, it offers a maximum range of up to 40 miles, certified by UL2849 for ultimate durability and electrical safety.

3. Full Suspension Comfort & Mechanical Disc Brakes:

Tame any terrain with the advanced full-suspension frame and adjustable front suspension forks, engineered to absorb heavy shocks and vibrations during commuting, sports, casual riding, or mountain adventures. Combined with front and rear mechanical disc brakes, it provides reliable, all-weather stopping power for wild rides.

4. Intelligent TFT Display & One-Touch Lighting:

The smart, multi-function TFT dashboard provides comprehensive real-time data including current speed, battery levels, and mileage mode selection at a glance. For enhanced visibility and security day or night, the effortless integrated system allows you to activate the bright front and rear lights with a simple touch.

5. 7-Speed Shifting & Geometric Ergonomics:

The precision 7-speed shifting system guarantees seamless performance and smooth gear transitions on steep hills or flat city streets. Specially designed with a wider and larger saddle for superior comfort, this 27.5" e-bike perfectly fits riders height between 160-180cm with a heavy-duty load capacity of up to 150kg.
